EZMB_TEMPORARY.title: Temporary
EZMB_TEMPORARY.description: This card only exists during this combat. It is removed after combat.
EZMB_PLANTED.title: Plant
EZMB_PLANTED.description: Planting is Seedbed handling an eligible card before it enters your hand. The card leaves this combat and you get 1 Withered Husk. It is not played, discarded, or exhausted, so those triggers do not fire. Temporary Status and Curse cards are gone for this combat; permanent Curses cannot be planted or deleted this way. A planted Blight Sprout is handled without being played and adds no Rootblight I after combat. A planted Rootblight is held still for this combat: it stays in your master deck at the same level and does not upgrade, split, get removed, or downgrade.
